articles.title: Reset a forgotten password
articles.content: From the demo support portal sign-in page, select Forgot password. Enter your registered email address, then follow the reset link sent to that address. Never share your password or reset link with support.

articles.title: Billing refunds and policy exceptions
articles.content: Billing refunds and requests for exceptions require a human billing specialist. Support automation may collect the request but cannot promise a refund or grant an exception.

articles.title: Invite a workspace member
articles.content: Workspace administrators can invite members from Settings, Members, Invite. This article does not document offline hardware-key recovery.
